tricks.name: Bounce
tricks.what: Hops in place a few times.

tricks.name: Peekaboo
tricks.what: Drops out of sight, then pops back up.

tricks.name: Zoomies
tricks.what: Races back and forth along the taskbar.

tricks.name: Nap anywhere
tricks.what: Curls up wherever it is and sleeps for a bit.

tricks.name: Sit
tricks.what: Sits down for a while and looks around.

tricks.name: Lie down
tricks.what: Lies down on its side and dozes.

tricks.name: Spin
tricks.what: Turns all the way around, twice.

tricks.name: Wave
tricks.what: Waves hello when you arrive, and whenever you ask.

behaviours.name: Clingy
behaviours.what: Drifts toward your mouse. Misses you faster.

behaviours.name: Show-off
behaviours.what: Does tricks on its own, more often.
